title: Retwined CSS frame correction for the D4 guard shear

companion_frame_update.rule: apply the same old_to_new D4 guard-tail permutation to the tracked Pauli/error coordinates and use retwined stabilizers H_X J^{-1}, H_Z J^{-1}

syndrome_equivariance.x_basis_errors: verified for all 240 coordinates and values 1,2
syndrome_equivariance.z_basis_errors: verified for all 240 coordinates and values 1,2
syndrome_equivariance.statement: For every basis error e, syndrome_H(e) equals syndrome_H_retwin(J e).
